user.title: Select your ESPHome deck
user.description: Select the already paired ESPHome device. Setup verifies the runtime v1 action signatures and all 15 key events. Compatible firmware is required; this integration uses HA's existing connection.

handoff.title: Hand over layout and bindings
handoff.description: ESP Deck will own all 15 visuals. Confirm that you have stopped other visual writers and duplicate key automations. The selected automations will be turned off (including running actions); the three shipped P4 helper scripts will be stopped. Their YAML is preserved. Optional: bind key 0 to an entity. Image URLs must already match the firmware's allowed origin; the artwork wizard comes later.

data.exclusive_control: I have stopped competing visual writers and duplicate bindings
data.label: Key 0 label

reconfigure.title: Replace the ESPHome association
reconfigure.description: Choose the compatible replacement. Existing layouts are preserved. Stop any manual replay and duplicate bindings on the replacement before continuing.

binding.title: Set an entity preset
binding.description: Replace one key in the draft with a light/switch toggle or script/scene action. On/off/unavailable feedback follows actual HA state. Applying activates the whole saved draft. The visual editor is a later stage.

data.key: Key (0–14, front view, left to right)
data.label: Label

repair.title: Repair entity mapping
repair.description: Select the existing ESPHome session and edge entities. Enable disabled entities first. HA renames are followed automatically. Each event must belong to this deck and support press/release.
